description: A search box that reports the query once typing pauses, with optional suggestions.

props.name: debounceMs
props.description: How long typing must pause before `onSearch` fires, in milliseconds.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Suggestions shown below the field while it has text.

events.name: onSearch
events.description: Fires with the query after typing pauses for `debounceMs`.

events.name: onSuggestionSelected
events.description: Fires with the suggestion the person picked.
